summary: SmarToken gives each existing user and eligible low-risk new Google signup a one-time $5 promotional balance for OpenAI-compatible API usage. It supports configured DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, GLM and other routes. Existing accounts are credited automatically; new users receive it after signup risk checks. No credit card is required. The campaign closes December 31, 2026 at 23:59:59 UTC+8.
claim_steps: Existing users: open SmarToken and check wallet history; the campaign migration adds the credit automatically.
New users: continue with Google and create an account before December 31, 2026 at 23:59:59 UTC+8.
Pass SmarToken's signup risk checks, then use the one-time $5 balance in Playground or through a console API key.

social_proof.title: $5 Free API Credit for Existing Users and New Sign-ups | SmarToken
social_proof.text: Every existing SmarToken user and every new sign-up gets $5 in free credit for OpenAI-compatible model calls. The deadline is December 31, 2026 at 23:59:59 UTC+8; no credit card is required.
